name: Write Verifiable Goal Loop
summary: Turn an open-ended objective into a bounded loop with evidence and stop rules.
description: Write a goal-driven agent loop with explicit constraints, validation, checkpoints, progress measures, and termination conditions. Use for long-running autonomous work where a simple step list is insufficient.
risk_reason: This skill turns an open-ended objective into a bounded loop with evidence and stop rules; it does not loop indefinitely or hide repeated failure.
refuses: It does not use vague goals such as make it better without measurable completion.
It does not reward activity counts that can be gamed instead of outcomes.
It does not loop indefinitely or hide repeated failure.

operational.latency_reason: The skill turns an open-ended objective into a bounded loop with evidence and stop rules, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
